title: ononis tridentata var. dentata
intro: Ononis tridentata var. dentata, commonly known as Spiny Restharrow, is a flowering plant species within the legume family. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dysentery. The therapeutic actions of Spiny Restharrow include anti-inflammatory and astringent properties, which can help to soothe and protect mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of Spiny Restharrow include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
